tools.name: generate_sales_list
tools.description: Generate a sales list of local businesses for an industry × area in Japan. Returns businesses with address, phone, email, website, Instagram, LINE Official, contact-form URL, rating, Google Maps URL, plus site_type (own / portal / sns / none) and weak-site checks (https, SSL error, mobile-friendly).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the API key owner's plan, monthly quota, remaining quota and credit balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_sales_list · Private data: generate_sales_list, get_account · Public sink: generate_sales_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_sales_list · Private data: generate_sales_list, get_account · Public sink: generate_sales_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
